message.content:
**Columbia University** *Columbia University* (often referred to simply as *Columbia*) is an Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. It was founded in 1754 as King's College by royal charter of King George II of Great Britain, making it one of the oldest institutions of higher education in the United States. In 1784, after the American Revolution, it was renamed Columbia College, and later became Columbia University. Key facts: | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Location** | Morningside Heights, Manhattan, New York City, NY | | **Founded** | 1754 (as King's College) | | **Type** | Private research university | | **Ivy League Member** | Yes | | **Campus Size** | ~36 acres (urban campus) | | **Student Body** | Approximately 30,000 students (undergraduate, graduate, professional) | | **Academic Schools** | • Columbia College (Undergraduate)
• Fu Foundation School of Engineering and Applied Science
• School of Architecture, Planning and Preservation
• School of Business (Columbia Business School)
• School of Journalism (Columbia Journalism School)
• School of Law (Columbia Law School)

• School of Social Work
• School of Public Health (Mailman School of Public Health)

• School of International and Public Affairs (SIPA) | | **Notable Alumni** | • Barack Obama (former U.S. President)

• Ruth Bader Ginsburg (Supreme Court Justice) | | **Research Highlights** | • Nobel Prize–winning research across disciplines (e.g., physics, chemistry, economics).
• Center for Computational Biology, Columbia Genome Center, etc. | | **Athletics** | NCAA Division I; teams known as the “Big Blue.” | Columbia’s main campus sits on Morningside Heights, adjacent to Columbia University Medical Center and the Cathedral of St. John the Divine. The university also has satellite campuses and facilities throughout New York City and beyond, including the Columbia University Irving Medical Center and the Columbia Center for Teaching and Learning.
